name: Realtime chat / Define delivery and room boundaries

intent.outcome: Design scalable realtime messaging between users.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. One bounded two-member conversation, fixed membership and a single sequence authority. State survives simulated node faults and checkpoints only. No live sockets, real authentication, cross-shard order, group messaging or production durability. All stages execute evolution Stage 1 simulation; none implements specification, deployment, operation or system stages. Detail levels describe inspection depth independently.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?
